A.claim: The bases of any Beal counterexample are pairwise coprime (gcd A B = gcd A C = gcd B C = 1), and no counterexample has A = B.

B.claim: Whenever 3|x, 3|y and 3|z, A^x + B^y = C^z has no positive solutions; in particular no Beal counterexample has such a signature, including the Fermat cubic (3,3,3).

level 3: the combination could close an infinite family
